nodes.title: Fieldless citation no longer rejected as an undeclared field
nodes.summary: citesADeclaredField in citation-validation.ts now accepts a citation that carries no field, once its cited evidence item is found, instead of failing the unconditional field-name match.

nodes.title: Fieldless citation acceptance in citesADeclaredField
nodes.summary: Two new unit tests cover a fieldless citation being accepted whatever fields its cited evidence item snapshotted, and the pre-existing field-mismatch test continues to cover a named-field citation's refusal; the verdict-conditioned half of both cited nodes remains outside what isCitationValid's signature can decide and is left unproven.
